stem: The average weight of 7 basketball players is 70 kg. When their coach joins them, the average weight of all 8 becomes 71 kg. How much does the coach weigh?
hints: Find the total weight before and after the coach joins. The difference is the coach.
Subtract the old total, 490 kg, from the new total, 568 kg.

solution.methodName: Compare totals before and after the change

steps.action: The coach is the difference: 568 − 490 = 78 kg.
steps.why: The only one added to the group is the coach, so all the extra weight is his.

trapNotes.71 kg: This is the new average. The coach pulled the average up, so he must weigh more than 71 kg.
trapNotes.77 kg: This is 70 + 7. The coach lifts the average of all 8 people, himself included, by 1 kg, so he is 8 × 1 = 8 kg above the old average of 70. Safest is to use totals: 568 − 490.
trapNotes.79 kg: This is 71 + 8. Above the new average of 71, the coach only has to make up 1 kg for each of the 7 players: 71 + 7 × 1. Safest is to use totals: 568 − 490.
